description: Turn an address or place name into coordinates, a formatted address and a place id (Google Geocoding API).

address.description: Street address, place name or plus code

api_key.description: Google Maps Platform API key (or set GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY)

language.description: Language code for the result, e.g. en

region.description: Country bias as a ccTLD, e.g. au

name: googlemaps_geocode
